claims.derivation_level: RECOMPUTED (per-gene EMC-minus-comparator mean_z delta, sign on each platform)
claims.note: REPORTED, NOT REPAIRED. Gene set ['BCL2', 'MCL1', 'BCL2L1', 'BCL2L2', 'BCL2A1']. Per-gene delta (EMC minus comparator) by platform: {'BCL2': {'GSE24369_series_matrix.txt.gz': -0.8084, 'GSE4303-GPL3290_series_matrix.txt.gz': -0.2349}, 'MCL1': {'GSE24369_series_matrix.txt.gz': -0.2664, 'GSE4303-GPL3290_series_matrix.txt.gz': -0.5563}, 'BCL2L1': {'GSE24369_series_matrix.txt.gz': -0.3801, 'GSE4303-GPL3290_series_matrix.txt.gz': -0.4755}, 'BCL2L2': {'GSE24369_series_matrix.txt.gz': 0.1231, 'GSE4303-GPL3290_series_matrix.txt.gz': -0.0457}, 'BCL2A1': {'GSE24369_series_matrix.txt.gz': 0.0371, 'GSE4303-GPL3290_series_matrix.txt.gz': -0.5299}}. BCL2, MCL1 and BCL2L1 are lower on both. BCL2L2 is HIGHER in EMC on GPL6244 (+0.1231) and lower on GPL3290 (-0.0457); BCL2A1 is HIGHER on GPL6244 (+0.0371) and lower on GPL3290 (-0.5299). Three of five, not five of five, are lower on both. What IS lower on both is the GROUP MEAN: the stored module score is LOWER in EMC on GPL6244 (delta -0.259, t -4.568, df 14.0, 5/5 readable) and on GPL3290 (delta -0.4097, t -2.538, df 9.8, 5/5 readable). The manuscript states a module-level result with a per-gene universal quantifier. The route verdict it supports ('against at the abundance level') is unaffected by this; the sentence is.
